title: "Elements"
description: "Every type the shipped schemas declare: what it is drawn as, what it means in a study, and the attributes it carries."
---

![One live instance of every element the shipped sets declare, in a labelled band per set.](../assets/img/examples/kitchensink.studyflow.png){#fig-catalog fig-alt="A tall diagram of dashed labelled bands, read top to bottom: BPMN events, BPMN gateways, BPMN activities, BPMN data and artifacts, studyflow core data elements, exec execution and scope, cognitive domain activities and research gateways, eeg biosignals, agentic LLM and agent workflows, and functional function composition beside a smaller band of data IO presets. Each band holds one instance of every element it contributes, drawn with its own shape and icon and labelled underneath." .fig-l}

Every element is a BPMN 2.0 element first, carrying a research type layered on top. The BPMN element fixes the shape and how a walk moves through it; the research type fixes what it means and which attributes it carries.

```yaml
Survey:
  type: bpmn:Task                     # the BPMN element: shape, and flow behaviour
  name: Post-battery survey
  extensionElements:
    - type: cognitive:Questionnaire   # the research type: meaning, and its own attributes
      instrument: phq-9

Done:
  type: bpmn:EndEvent
  redirectTo: https://example.org/thanks   # an added field, straight on the element
```

Which sets ship, and which load by default, is in [Extending the notation](../concepts/extending.qmd#what-ships).

## The study

Attributes of the study as a whole, edited with nothing selected.

| Attribute | Holds |
|:--|:--|
| `authors`, `version` | who wrote it, and which revision this is |
| `runtime` | where it is meant to run: `browser`, `cloud`, `local`, or `hpc` |
| `tags` | short classification labels |
| `seed` | the root seed; pinned, every gateway draw replays |
| `documentation` | prose about any element, in markdown |
| `checklist` | reporting items on any element, as markdown task items |

`documentation` and `checklist` sit on every element, not only on the study.

## What a participant meets

::: {layout-ncol=5}
![Questionnaire](../assets/img/elements/questionnaire.svg){width="110" fig-alt="A rounded rectangle with a clipboard-and-pencil icon in its top-left corner, labelled Questionnaire."}

![CognitiveTask](../assets/img/elements/cognitive_task.svg){width="110" fig-alt="A rounded rectangle with a jigsaw-piece icon in its top-left corner."}

![BehaverseTask](../assets/img/elements/behaverse_task.svg){width="110" fig-alt="A rounded rectangle with a hexagon icon in its top-left corner, labelled Behaverse Task."}

![Instruction](../assets/img/elements/instruction.svg){width="110" fig-alt="A rounded rectangle with an information icon in its top-left corner, labelled Instruction."}

![Rest](../assets/img/elements/rest.svg){width="110" fig-alt="A rounded rectangle with an armchair icon in its top-left corner, labelled Rest."}
:::

| Type | Drawn as | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Questionnaire` | `bpmn:Task` | A self-report form: a standard instrument, or one of your own. | `instrument` |
| `CognitiveTask` | `bpmn:Task` | A cognitive test, delivered by an experiment package. | `instrument`, `implementation`, `configurations` |
| `BehaverseTask` | `bpmn:Task` | A test from the Behaverse battery, named by a scene code. A `CognitiveTask` whose instrument is fixed. | `behaverseScene`, `configurations`, `agentType`, `botConfigurations` |
| `Instruction` | `bpmn:Task` | Text the participant reads. Nothing is recorded. | `content` |
| `Rest` | `bpmn:Task` | A break, or a resting-state period. A narrower `CognitiveTask`. | `configurations` |

| Attribute | Values |
|:--|:--|
| `instrument` | an experiment package — PsychoPy, jsPsych, lab.js, OpenSesame, Behaverse — or a scale name, or an identifier of your own |
| `configurations` | YAML the named instrument reads: trial counts, durations, block structure |
| `agentType` | `human`, or `bot` — the same instrument answered by a model |
| `botConfigurations` | how that model is driven; appears once `agentType` is `bot` |

## Entry and exit

| On | Attribute | Says |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the start event | `consentFormUri` | the address of the consent document that gates entry; unset, entry is not gated |
| the end event | `redirectTo` | where the participant is sent; `{COMPLETION_CODE}` is substituted with the issued code |
| the end event | `completionCodeType` | `none`, `static` (the fixed `completionCode`), or `dynamic` |
| the end event | `completionCode` | the code itself, when the type is `static` |

## Branching

::: {layout-ncol=2}
![A two-arm random assignment](../assets/img/elements/random_gateway_pattern.svg){width="300" fig-alt="A diamond with a dice icon, fed by one incoming arrow, with two arrows leaving it toward two separate boxes."}

![RandomGateway](../assets/img/elements/random_gateway.svg){width="90" fig-alt="A diamond with a dice icon inside, labelled Random Gateway."}
:::

| Type | Drawn as | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `RandomGateway` | `bpmn:ExclusiveGateway` | Allocation: each participant takes one outgoing edge at random, one arm per edge. | `algorithm`, `probabilityFunction`, `stratifyBy`, `strata` |
| `EligibilityGateway` | `bpmn:ExclusiveGateway` | Screening: criteria stated on the gateway, in readable sentences. | `inclusionCriteria`, `exclusionCriteria` |
| A plain gateway | `bpmn:ExclusiveGateway` | A decision written out as one condition per outgoing edge. | `conditionExpression`, on each edge |

| Attribute | Values |
|:--|:--|
| `algorithm` | `probabilistic`, `round-robin` |
| `probabilityFunction` | `uniform`, `normal`, `exponential`, `poisson` |
| `stratifyBy`, `strata` | the variable to balance on, and one entry per stratum |
| `inclusionCriteria`, `exclusionCriteria` | one criterion per entry |

Screening and allocation are separate types because they answer to different standards: eligibility turns on criteria a reviewer must be able to read, allocation on a draw nobody should be able to predict.

## Who takes part

| Type | Drawn as | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Actor` | `bpmn:Participant` | A pool of participants — human, model, software agent, or instrument. | `actorType`, `spec`, `promptTemplate` |

`actorType` is `human`, `llm`, `agent`, or `instrument`; `spec` names the model, checkpoint, or device the pool stands for. A pool stands for a group rather than one person, and drawing one turns the file into a collaboration. Two pools that deal with each other are joined by choreography tasks, one box per exchange.

## When each step happens

| Attribute | On | Values |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `onset` | any activity or event | a timestamp, an offset such as `T0+30min`, or a label |
| `duration` | any activity or event | `30min`, or an ISO 8601 duration |
| `progress` | any activity or event | a percentage, or `done`, `blocked`, `in progress` |
| `timeCycle` | a timer start event | a five-field cron expression, or a repeating ISO 8601 interval |
| `timeDuration`, `timeDate` | a timer catch event | a delay, or a fixed moment |
| `condition` | a conditional catch event | wait until this becomes true |
| `loopCondition` | the repeat marker on a step | repeat while this holds |
| `completionCondition` | an ad-hoc sub-process | stop when this holds |

These are the *study's* schedule, in visits and days, and are what the Timeline view projects. A recording's own clock is separate, below.

## Data

| Type | Drawn as | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Dataset` | `bpmn:DataStoreReference` | A logical collection the study reads or produces, under a declared standard. | `format`, `schema`, `catalog`, `storage`; `bdmDataLevel` or `bidsDataType` |
| `Schema` | `bpmn:DataObjectReference` | How data are laid out: columns, types, requiredness. | `format` (`csvw`, `linkml`, `jsonschema`), `body` |
| `Table` | `bpmn:DataObjectReference` | Rows and columns, with that structure committed to. | `format`, `schema`, `rowCount` |
| `Timeseries` | `bpmn:DataObjectReference` | A continuously sampled recording. | `samplingRate`, `channelCount`, `units`, `recordingDuration`, `format` |
| `EventMarker` | `bpmn:DataObjectReference` | Time-stamped occurrences inside a recording. | `eventType`, `eventOnset`, `eventOffset`, `eventCount` |
| `Parameters` | `bpmn:DataObjectReference` | Settings wired into the steps that read them, so a study varies by value rather than by redrawing. | `values` |
| `DataCatalog` | not drawn | A listing a dataset is published in; a dataset names one. | `url` |
| any of them | — | Where the value lives. Unset, it only passes between steps. | `uri` |

| `format` on a `Dataset` | Standard | Then declares |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `bdm` | [Behaverse Data Model](https://behaverse.org/data-model/) | `bdmDataLevel`: events, trials, or models |
| `bids` | [Brain Imaging Data Structure](https://bids.neuroimaging.io/) | `bidsDataType`: anat, beh, eeg, func, meg, … |
| `psych-ds` | [Psych-DS](https://psych-ds.github.io/) | — |
| `kedro` | [Kedro datasets](https://docs.kedro.org/projects/kedro-datasets/) | — |

`eventOnset` and `eventOffset` are seconds from the start of a recording; `onset` and `duration` on an activity are the study's schedule. Run state that a condition reads by name is a `bpmn:Property` on the container that declares it, and is never drawn.

## What a step runs

| Attribute | On | Holds |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `implementation` | any activity | the software the step runs, as `<scheme>://<ref>[@<version>]` |
| `script` | a script task | code carried in the study itself |
| `additionalArguments` | any activity | literal arguments the drawn data edges do not supply; the reserved `args` key holds positional ones |

| Scheme | Names |
|:--|:--|
| `python://` | an importable callable, reaching into a class where needed |
| `docker://` | a container image, pinned by tag or digest |
| `https://`, `file://` | a script by address, or a local one |
| anything else | accepted, recorded, and reported as unresolved |

Four operations say what shape the work has. Each is an ordinary service task pinning its own operation, drawn with a function marker.

| Type | Means |
|:--|:--|
| `Transform` | Applies a function to data — the general case the other three narrow. |
| `Map` | Applies it to every item in a stream: every trial, every participant, every session. |
| `Reduce` | Combines a stream into one value: a mean, a fitted model, a report. |
| `Filter` | Keeps the items matching a condition, dropping the rest from the *data* — where a gateway changes the *path*. |

## Agents and model calls

| Type | Drawn as | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Agent` | `bpmn:AdHocSubProcess` | A model calling the tools drawn inside it, in an order it decides. | `model`, `systemPrompt`, `toolChoice`, `temperature`, `maxTurns` |
| `Router` | `bpmn:ExclusiveGateway` | A branch a model picks among the labels on the outgoing edges. | `model`, `instructions` |
| `LLMCall` | `bpmn:ServiceTask` | One model call: a prompt in, a response out. | `model`, `prompt`, `temperature`, `maxTokens` |
| `Tool` | `bpmn:ServiceTask` | Something an agent may call, run like any other step. | `kind`, `purpose`, `implementation` |
| `HumanApproval` | `bpmn:UserTask` | Pauses the run until a person approves, edits, or rejects. | `question` |
| `Prompt` | `bpmn:DataObjectReference` | A prompt kept as data, wired into the calls that read it. | `template` |
| `Memory` | `bpmn:DataStoreReference` | What an agent carries between turns. | `scope` |

An agent stops at its `completionCondition` and never runs past `maxTurns`. A guardrail or a model-as-judge is an `LLMCall` with a strict prompt; retrieval is a `Tool` whose `kind` is retrieval.

## Biosignals

| Type | Drawn as | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `Session` | `bpmn:Participant` | One acquisition session, carrying the device settings every phase inside it shares. | `device`, `modalities` |
| `Recording` | `bpmn:DataStoreReference` | The biosignal data a session produces. A narrower `Dataset`. | `modalities`, `channels`, `samplingRateHz` |

`modalities` covers EEG, EMG, ECG, EOG, EDA, PPG, eye tracking, head motion, and audio.

## The provenance trail

| Type | Means | Attributes |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `Activity` | One entry of the trail: something that happened to this studyflow, and when. | `action`, `when`, `who`, `with`, `what`, `run`, `seed`, `note` |

None of the trail is drawn. [Execution and provenance](../concepts/execution.qmd#the-plan-and-the-record-in-one-object) specifies what each action records.
